text: The National Flood Forecasting and Early Warning Expansion in Nepal aims to enhance the country's capacity to predict and respond to flood risks. This initiative is designed to improve flood forecasting and early warning systems, leveraging best practices from global evidence to reduce loss of life and livelihoods by providing lead time for preparedness and anticipatory actions. It focuses on enhancing observational networks, forecasting models, communication channels, and multi-sector coordination to ensure timely and effective responses to flood threats.
